name: Generate a local file data-product source

checks.check: The generated closure reflects the pinned three-model file contract and keeps the source as local non-secret topology.
JSONL uses dlt read_jsonl, Parquet uses dlt read_parquet, and plain JSON uses a custom JSON loader rather than the JSONL reader.
The relative file-source path, model directories, resource names, and file-source service match the supplied contract.
Rows are landed through the standard local DuckDB pipeline without a network client or live-provider claim.
